data.body:
## **Tilt-Bed Truck Delivery**

### _Best for urban areas, tight spaces, and limited-access sites._

Our **Tilt-Bed Truck** is ideal for delivering shipping containers up to **24 feet in length** or a combination of smaller units (e.g., two 10-foot containers). This is our most compact delivery truck, designed for **tight spaces, city deliveries, mountain roads, and restricted-access locations**.

✅ **Delivery Process:**

• The truck backs up to the designated drop-off location.

• The bed tilts, allowing the container to slide off smoothly into position.

• Requires a **minimum of 60 feet of straight-line clearance** for safe unloading.

🚛 **Important Considerations:**

• Let us know if you have clearance concerns at the site or along the delivery route.

• We can preview the route before delivery to ensure a smooth process.

• When placing your order, you’ll choose whether the container doors face the cab or rear of the truck—this determines the final door placement upon delivery.

• **Best for 24’ and smaller rental storage containers.**

Get a Quote

## **Tilt-Bed Truck & Trailer Delivery**

### _Ideal for larger containers and multi-container deliveries._

For **containers up to 45 feet in length**, we use a **Tilt-Bed Truck & Trailer** combo. This setup can transport **multiple units**, including **two 20-foot containers or four 10-foot containers**, making it a great option for bulk deliveries.

✅ **Delivery Process:**

• The truck backs up to your desired placement location.

• The trailer tilts, and the container smoothly rolls off into position.

• Requires **at least 100 feet of straight-line clearance** for proper unloading.

🚛 **Important Considerations:**

• Ensure adequate clearance at the delivery site and along the access route.

• We offer **route previews** to confirm delivery feasibility.

• Specify whether you want the container doors facing the **cab or rear of the truck** before delivery.

• **Best for larger storage solutions, including 40’ standard, 40’ high cube, and 45’ high cube containers.**

## Delivery requirements

To ensure a **smooth and hassle-free** container delivery using our **hydraulic tilt trailer**, please ensure the following space requirements:

**Straight, Unobstructed Space Needed:**

• **20-Foot Container** – At least **110 feet** of straight, open space.

• **40-Foot Container** – At least **130 feet** of straight, open space.

**Height Clearance:**

• **Driving Clearance** – A minimum of **14 feet** required.

• **Unloading Clearance** – A minimum of **22 feet** along the entire unloading path to accommodate the trailer’s lift.

**Width Clearance:**

• A **minimum of 10 feet** is required along the delivery path.

**Important Considerations:**

• Measurement starts from where the container will be placed and extends **forward in a straight line**.

• The delivery truck **cannot turn** within the **110’ or 130’ required space**.

data.body:
**What is Drive-Up Storage?**
Drive-up storage is the gold standard for accessibility in the self-storage industry. Imagine an extension of your own garage that you can access on your schedule—that is essentially what a drive-up unit offers. Unlike interior climate-controlled units that might require navigating hallways or elevators, drive-up units are located on the ground level with exterior roll-up doors.

You simply pull your vehicle directly up to the door of your unit, roll it up, and start loading or unloading. There is no need to carry heavy boxes across icy parking lots or maneuver awkward furniture through narrow corridors. It is a straightforward, "park and load" experience designed to save you time and physical effort.

**The Benefits of Drive-Up Storage**
For our Monticello customers, drive-up access is more than just a convenience—it’s a necessity for the seasons. Here is why this feature is our most requested:

- **Effortless Loading in Any Weather:** In Minnesota, speed matters when the temperature drops. Drive-up access allows you to back your vehicle right up to the unit lip, minimizing the time you spend exposed to the elements.

- **Ideal for Heavy & Bulky Items:** If you are a contractor storing tools or a homeowner moving a sectional sofa, avoiding long walks and elevators is a game-changer. You can transfer items directly from your truck bed or trailer into the unit with zero hassle.

- **Vehicle & Recreational Storage:** Our larger drive-up units (such as the 10’x24’, 10’x30’, and 20’x30’ sizes) are perfect for storing the toys that make living in Wright County fun. Many of our units feature extra-large 10’x10’ overhead doors, specifically designed to accommodate taller items like boats with wakeboard towers, fish houses, or campers.

- **Time Efficiency:** Whether you are grabbing camping gear for a weekend at Lake Maria State Park or picking up inventory for your business, you can get in and out in minutes.

items.question: How much space is required on-site for a successful delivery?
items.answer:
Delivery is typically performed using a tilt-bed truck, which needs a significant amount of space to safely unload.

  • 20-foot container: Requires approximately 70 feet of straight-line clearance.

  • 40-foot container: Requires approximately 120 feet of straight-line clearance.

  • In both cases, you need a minimum of 10 feet of width and 16 feet of overhead clearance (since the truck tilts up). The site must be clear of low wires, trees, and obstacles.

items.question: What kind of ground preparation is needed for the container?
items.answer:
The container must be placed on hard, dry, and level ground. Unloading on soft, muddy, or severely uneven surfaces can lead to the truck getting stuck or the container twisting once placed (which makes the doors difficult to open).

  • Ideal surfaces: Asphalt, concrete, gravel, or compacted soil.

  • Foundation: We strongly recommend placing the container on level supports (like railroad ties, concrete blocks, or a gravel bed) at the four corners to prevent sinking and to allow air circulation, which prevents rust and moisture build-up underneath.

items.question: How is the container actually unloaded from the truck?
items.answer:
1. The driver backs the truck into the designated spot.

  2. The trailer bed is raised to an angle, and the container is slowly slid off the back, using a winch to control the descent.

  3. The truck pulls forward as the container rolls onto the ground.

  • Alternative: For tight spots or over obstacles, a side-loader or crane (HIAB) truck may be required, which typically incurs an additional fee.

items.question: Can I specify which way the container doors face?
items.answer:
Yes, you must specify your preference when ordering.

  • Since the container is slid off the back of the truck, the door placement is determined by how the driver loads it onto the trailer at the depot.

  • You will choose either "Doors to the Cab" (doors are the last thing off the truck, landing furthest from the road) or "Doors to the Rear" (doors are the first thing off the truck, landing closest to the road).

items.question: What happens if the delivery driver cannot access the site?
items.answer:
If the site is inaccessible due to obstacles, soft ground, insufficient clearance, or an unprepared foundation, the driver cannot safely unload the container.

  • This may result in a "failed delivery" charge and the need to reschedule after the site issues have been corrected. To avoid this, please review the clearance requirements and site preparation steps carefully before the delivery date.

data.body:
At **Affordabox**, we believe storage shouldn’t be stressful — it should be simple, secure, and affordable.

What started as a small, family-owned operation has grown into a trusted name for **portable storage, shipping containers, dumpsters, and self-storage** across the Midwest and beyond. Whether you’re a homeowner tackling a remodel, a contractor managing a job site, or a business owner needing extra space, we’ve built our services around one promise: we make your project easier.

From our clean, **weather-proof white box containers** to our **durable 20’ and 40’ shipping containers** and quick-turn **roll-off dumpsters**, every delivery is handled with care and precision. Our team uses advanced “Mule” technology for tight-space placement and prides itself on doing business the right way — with honesty, communication, and that neighborly touch you only get from a local company.

Because to us, it’s not just about delivering a box — it’s about delivering peace of mind.

**Local service, fast delivery, and fair pricing — that’s the Affordabox way.**
